caveats: TNG-only prior (docs/wl_tsz_plan.md sec6 checklist row 8, marked open honesty-section item)
Mass floor: direct painting requires M200c>=1e13; the 1e12-1e13 band is reuse-only, capturing 28.7% (4xR200 paste) / 51.6% (full patch)
tau is a velocity-free electron column (kSZ observable needs velocity for Delta-T_kSZ; deferred to a later paper) -- src/bind/inference/lightcone_maps.py docstring

High-ell convergence power upturn is a CIC/aliasing artifact common-mode between DMO and BIND; cancels in same-pipeline ratios used for all science statistics; --mas_correct exists but is only needed for absolute (not ratio) validation

Painting is 2D projected onto lightcone slabs, not full 3D fields -- inferred from the architecture (bind.model emits 128x128 2D maps per CLAUDE.md); not found as an explicit quoted caveat sentence in the sources, flag as synthesized

Cl^yy has an open -12% deficit at fiducial vs hydro truth, not yet root-caused (docs/wl_tsz_plan.md sec6 checklist row 1); candidate cause is mean-y completeness (BIND mean-y 1.05e-6 vs Planck ~1.6e-6, ~35% of <y> attributed to M<1e13 halos + unbound gas)

Response-closure validation (twobound extremes vs independent CAMELS hydro runs at matched theta) is an open/unchecked item (docs/wl_tsz_plan.md sec6 checklist row 2), distinct from the completed fiducial-closure validation
High-mass extrapolation beyond the CAMELS-50 training range (tops out at a few x 1e14) is unaudited (docs/wl_tsz_plan.md sec3.5, checklist row 6)

The per-peak bridge (Delta-kappa/kappa vs Delta-ln-M_gas) has ~100% per-peak scatter; only the per-run-averaged r=0.50 recovers a population-level signal -- the bridge is a population, not an individual-halo, statement
Resolution-gate validation (TNG300-2-Dark/-3-Dark) was planned but never executed; no results exist to report as of this dossier
